QuestInfo.name: The Stranded Cutter
QuestInfo.0: The castaway is named Cutter, and he's been here for a long time. Now, how did he end up here?
QuestInfo.1: Cutter told you that he was once a pirate, and also the designer of the Battleship Nautilius. You asked him a little about how he got stranded here, and he said it was a long story. If a guy like him has been stuck here for so long, that's bad news for you...
QuestInfo.2: Cutter said he got washed out to sea while working on a new weapon for his pirates. You asked him about the weapon, and he boasted about how it was more powerful than any other weapon. Hmmm...

0.0: Right, introductions. Let's do this. I'm Cutter, shipwrecked pirate extraordinaire. Happened after a long stint as a master engineer on the fair #bNautilus#k.\r\n#L0##bYou're a pirate?#l\n#k
0.1: Indeed! Pirate by name, pirate by nature. However, I'm a perfectly civil sort of pirate. No walking planks or shivering me timbers or such around here. Nothing to fear from me, not at all.\r\n#L0##b(He certainly sounds nice enough.)#l\n#k
0.2: You want to know how I ended up here? Yes, I suppose there isn't too much else to discuss, is there? It's a long story, filled with action and drama. I suppose I could spare the time to tell it if you wanted... Okay, you don't have to twist my arm. Let's see here, it was a dark and stormy night...\r\n#L0##b(You never said a word.)#l\n#k
0.3: This is an extremely long story, so listen carefully.

no.0: Eh? What was that? Ghosts? Hm... Oh, are you not interested in my story anymore?

1.0: I was working aboard the Nautilus, at the time. I designed her, you know. That boat? All me, right here. I'm a weapons designer, you see. Best kind of engineering. Things blow up, but they're supposed to. Great excuse. I was serving under Captain Kyrin, working on a secret project for her.
1.1: She charged me with designing a new personal weapon that could make the pirates the most powerful fighters in Maple World. Can you imagine that? Pirates with a new super weapon? We'd have pirates everywhere, running the world. Free eye patches and rum for everyone! Good times.
1.2: I'll tell you, it wasn't an easy thing, but I never do things the easy way. Easy is boring. I challenged myself...and I DID IT! Oh, it was glorious. Perfect accuracy, high rate of fire, devastating damage. Thing of beauty. There was just one problem.
1.3: The darn thing was too heavy! All that perfection came at a price, and that price was all the extra plating and casing it needed. Strip that off, and it turns back into a regular pea-shooter. And let me tell you, pea-shooting does not make a super weapon.
1.4: But hey, I thought, I'm Cutter! I'm the best darn engineer in the fleet! So I got back to work, and sure enough, I solved my own problem. I got that sucker down to a tenth of its original weight! Still a bit of a beast to hold, but better than nothing, right? So, says I, time for a little test.
1.5: I had to go out to sea to test it. I tried firing the first one at a brick wall and, well, there happened to be a barn about a mile past the wall... Anyway, sea's much safer. No sheep to explode. I hopped in one of our little boats and headed out into the deep sea.
1.6: The tests were beautiful. Glorious. It was the dawn of a new age of blowing things up. I was so excited...well, I didn't see the rocks until it was too late. I can only assume the boat was smashed to splinters.
1.7: I woke up on this island after...heck, I have no idea. Ahh, it's a cryin' shame, it is. I never even got to show Kyrin the working prototype. All that work... If I could only get off this island...
